preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have been authorized by the owner
Contract must hold some BNB balance (native currency) to steal

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or authorized address, call clearStuckBalance_sender(100) to drain all BNB from the contract to your address. This function is marked 'authorized' and transfers a percentage of contract's BNB balance to msg.sender. Use 100% to drain all funds. Alternatively, use rescueToken to steal any other ERC20 tokens held by the contract.
